title: Chicken Tagine
description: A Mexican twist on the Moroccan classic, this dish is a fusion of spices and flavors.
instructions: Season the chicken breasts with salt, cumin, coriander, and chili powder.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Brown the chicken on both sides and transfer to a baking dish.
In a small bowl, mix together the tagine spice, honey, and lime juice. Pour the mixture over the chicken and cover with foil.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the foil and bake for an additional 5-10 minutes or until the chicken is lightly browned and caramelized.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
